recipe_name: Thai Green Chicken and Pak Choi Rice
cooking_instructions: Cook rice covered for 10 minutes and rest covered for 10. Slice carrot and pak choi. Stir-fry vegetables for 4 minutes, add diced chicken and brown for 5 minutes. Stir in curry paste, then coconut milk and a splash of water. Simmer 8-10 minutes until chicken is fully cooked. Season with soy and lime and spoon over rice.

recipe_name: Smoky Harissa Butter Beans and Sweet Potato Toast
cooking_instructions: Roast diced sweet potato at 200 C fan for 25-35 minutes until tender. Drain beans and simmer with passata and a splash of water for 8 minutes. Stir in harissa, roast sweet potato and spinach and cook 3 minutes. Toast ciabatta; serve topped with feta and crispy onions.

recipe_name: Harissa Butter Bean and Feta Bake
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 3 garlic cloves. Heat oven to 200 C fan. Simmer beans with passata and harissa for 5 minutes. Stir in chopped kale and transfer to an oven dish. Top with crumbled feta and breadcrumbs and bake for 12-15 minutes until bubbling. Rub split ciabatta with garlic and oil and toast for 5 minutes; serve alongside.

recipe_name: Lemon Herb Cod with Crushed Peas
cooking_instructions: For two servings, measure 2 garlic cloves. Boil chopped potatoes for 15-20 minutes until tender. Simmer peas for 3 minutes, drain and crush with half the butter and chopped parsley. Pat cod dry and pan-fry in remaining butter for 3-5 minutes each side until opaque and flaky. Add garlic briefly, squeeze over lemon and serve with potatoes and peas.
